statements.impact_statement: The PDP runs OPA in inline mode via OPAL over OPA's REST API and never pulls OCI artifacts, so oras-go's tar/hardlink extraction (the vulnerable code path in CVE-2026-50163) is never executed. oras-go is an indirect dependency of the bundled OPA (built from permitio/permit-opa); no fixed release exists yet (all versions <= 2.6.1 are affected, upstream fix expected ~2026-07-15). This waiver is temporary and must be removed once permit-opa bumps oras-go to the patched release. Tracked under PER-15358.
